body: @soheilhy  this might have been caused by your PR https://github.com/grpc/grpc/pull/20328/files. Any ideas?

sorry about the issue. I restructured the benchmark to be more resilient, by instructing both server and client to die at the same time before waiting for them: 
https://github.com/grpc/grpc/pull/20328/files#diff-e698c28672462818d86ab7b3a483c0a5

I believe depending on timing client may receive a cancellation if server stops faster.  It's really benign and I think I'd be able to fix it.

I'm travelling today to SVL.  Would you mind if I send a fix tomorrow or is this urgent?
It's not urgent, thanks for taking a look!

Other benchmarks seem to be having similar trouble (see missing dots due to failed scenario runs)

issue.body:
In https://github.com/grpc/grpc/pull/20328, we started shutting down the
servers and the clients at the time to make the benchmark resilient.

Since servers and clients are shutdown in parallel, there is always a
chance that they observe cancelled RPCs. This resulted in QPS benchmarks
failing.  In this commit, we also accept cancelled RPCs in addition to
OK RPCs.

Fixes #20509
